description: Real recorded incident: a three-fault composite on Hotel Reservation (geo, rate, recommendation), detected to independently-verified health. 125 firing-stream transitions across the incident; the responder fixed the fault and health cleared. An incident-class detector fired only after dispatch (before=false, after=true, no_incident=false).
scrubbed: detector-firings.jsonl: copied verbatim. Its fields carry no environment-specific detail (no absolute paths, pod/session ids, cluster names, git SHAs, or IPs). The incident_id is an app-name+epoch-nanos token and recorded_at timestamps are kept, because event_id is content-addressed over them and the replay re-derives the real recorded ids.

closure.json: extracted from sdo_production_receipt_strict.json -- only the detector_timeline and the three analysis booleans (the IncidentClosure fields the replay re-derives). The receipt's environment-specific fields (controller_pod_uid, responder_session_id, runtime_artifacts absolute directory, source/deployed commit SHAs, controller/responder/validator image refs) are deliberately NOT copied.

No RuntimeState dump exists in stored results (the controller's state ConfigMap is not exported per incident), so this fixture has no state.json and the state-round-trip dimension does not run for it.
